ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  The document confirms that 5paisa Capital Limited has fully utilized the Rs. 468.82 crore raised through its Rights Issue by September 30, 2026, with both the company and its Monitoring Agency (CARE Ratings Limited) reporting no deviation from the stated objectives. Funds were deployed for margin deposits, debt repayment, general corporate purposes, and issue expenses. A minor internal reallocation of Rs. 1.01 crore between issue expenses and General Corporate Purposes was noted and explicitly stated as compliant with the offer document, with no red flags or delays identified.
